pages.title: Connect Game
pages.text: A normal game of Connect Four. Ha! Not. Your opponent has some special skills and will randomly choose how to play.

pages.title: Frosted Log
pages.text: A Frosted Log is used on the Connect Game block to start the game. Interact with the NPC that spawns to start the game.

pages.title: Advanced Resolve Map
pages.text: An Advanced Celestial Map of Resolve is given for succesfully completing the game.
